cross_references.note: §§1400-1401 authentication is required before §1271 business records exception can be invoked. Authentication of the record's identity is the threshold; §1271 is the hearsay exception that follows.
A business record that appears altered fails BOTH §1402 (altered document burden) AND §1271(d) (trustworthiness). Both arguments run concurrently.

RedJag wrong CARFAX: §1271 analysis of wrong vehicle history report — §1271(d) trustworthiness fails for a CARFAX belonging to a different VIN. VEH §11713 is the dealer fraud claim; §1271 is the evidentiary vehicle.

When original business records are unavailable, §1521 secondary evidence rule applies. §1271 establishes what the business record IS; §1521 determines whether a copy or secondary evidence of it may be admitted.

Synthetic identity documents and fabricated business records: §1271(a)/(b)/(d) failure analysis of forged identity documents; PC §530.5 is the criminal theory; §1271 is why the forged records fail in court.
